items.title: Death toll in Baloch Colony building collapse rises to 11 as rescuers recover three more bodies
items.description:
KARACHI: Rescue workers recovered three more bodies from the rubble of a six-storey building that collapsed near Karachi’s Baloch Colony area on Saturday, taking the death toll to 11.
On Wednesday, three people were killed and 14 others injured when the under-construction building — reportedly being constructed illegally on a residential plot — collapsed. items.description:

items.description:
LAHORE: During checking at Raiwind Railway Station, the railway police’ special branch staff recovered on Friday two dogs being transported illegally, without booking, in the Allama Iqbal Express (9-Up) power van.
According to officials, the train’s power plant operator, Mohammad Khan, allegedly charged Rs5,000 for transporting the dogs from Karachi, without booking them under the prescribed railway procedure.
The animals were reportedly to be handed over to a person at Kot Lakhpat Railway Station.
